notes: B-103, both readings in one declaration. Tide Skimmer: 'Whenever you attack with two or more creatures with flying, draw a card.' is about the declaration (CR 508.3d): one trigger, one card, however many flyers attack. Hooded Blightfang (it stays home): 'Whenever a creature you control with deathtouch attacks, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.' is about each attacker (CR 508.3a, 603.2c): one trigger per deathtouch attacker. The Skimmer and two flying deathtouch Vipers attack: one card drawn, two drains. Seat 1 loses 2 and takes 2 + 1 + 1 (20 -> 14), seat 0 gains 2 (22). Before the fix the Blightfang drained once (15 and 21).
